sections.heading: In depth
sections.body: Health insurance pays for covered medical services after cost-sharing. Plans differ in networks, premiums, and out-of-pocket limits. In the US, major sources are employer plans, marketplace plans, and public programs like Medicare and Medicaid. Educational content only — not financial advice. Consult a licensed insurance professional for your situation.
